text.aria-label: Title text 'L-1d (fold 2026-01, seed 0) barely changes its band when its lead input is replaced. Day 1, day 10, and a shuffled lead change the clock; the two same-hour conditions change only the lead.'
text.tspan: L-1d (fold 2026-01, seed 0) barely changes its band when its lead input is replaced.
Day 1, day 10, and a shuffled lead change the clock; the two same-hour conditions change only the lead.
